language.label: Language
welcome.title: Welcome to Hive
welcome.description: A blockchain where your account is your identity, and Keychain helps you interact with it securely.
hive.title: What is Hive?
hive.description: Think of Hive as one shared network where many different apps run, all using the same account that you control.
hive.oneAccountDescription: A single Hive account works everywhere, so you do not need to create a new account for every app.
hive.oneEcosystemDescription: Social, games, communities, and apps all share the same network and account.
hive.controlDescription: Your keys, your account. You decide what gets signed and what doesn't.
account.title: Your Hive account, and its keys
account.description: Hive accounts use different keys for different permissions. A key for posting cannot move your funds, and vice versa.
account.postingDescription: Used for everyday social actions such as posting, commenting, and voting. This is the key you will use most often.
account.activeDescription: Used for transfers, managing assets, and governance. Anything that moves value or changes your account.
account.memoDescription: Used to encrypt and decrypt private memos attached to transfers, so notes stay confidential.
account.ownerDescription: The most powerful key. It can recover your account and regenerate every other key. Keep it offline.
account.warningDescription: Keep backups of your keys stored safely offline, and never paste a private key into a website. Keychain keeps your Active, Posting, and Memo keys on your device. Your Owner key should stay offline.
tokens.description: Three forms of value exist on Hive. Here is how they relate to each other in plain terms.
tokens.hiveDescription: The main token of the Hive blockchain. It is liquid and transferable, and is used for transactions, trades, and powering up.
tokens.hpDescription: HIVE in its vested form. More Hive Power means more voting weight, more resource credits, and more governance influence.
tokens.hbdDescription: A stablecoin pegged to the US dollar. It is used for transactions that need a stable value and can be locked in savings to earn interest.
tokens.powerDescription: Power up instantly; power down to HIVE weekly over 13 weeks.
tokens.stableDescription: Move between HIVE and HBD. HBD is a stablecoin pegged to the dollar for steady value.
explore.title: What can you do on Hive?
explore.description: One account opens up a whole ecosystem. Tap a card to see the kinds of things you can do.
explore.createDescription: Publish posts, leave comments, vote on content, and build communities around what you love.
explore.connectDescription: Join communities, follow people, and take part in social experiences across the network.
explore.playDescription: Dive into Hive games and interactive applications where your account and assets carry over.
explore.exploreDescription: Manage assets and tokens, discover markets, make swaps, and try out new applications.
explore.configNote: Featured applications can be added to the content configuration without changing this layout.
keychain.title: Meet Hive Keychain
keychain.description: Hive is the network. dApps are the applications. Keychain is the secure interface that connects you to both without exposing your keys.
keychain.loginDescription: A site asks who you are. Keychain proves it, without handing over a password.
keychain.signDescription: A site wants an action. You review it, approve it, and Keychain signs it on the blockchain.
keychain.keysDescription: Your keys never leave your device. Keychain only uses them to sign what you approve.
login.title: How login with Keychain works
login.description: If you have Hive Keychain installed, this sends a real request to sign a unique login challenge with your Posting key. Otherwise it runs as a simulation.
login.signInPrompt: Sign in to continue to this application.
login.noKeyShared: No private key is shared with this website.
login.liveDemo: Live Keychain request · no transaction is broadcast
login.installPrompt: Install Hive Keychain first to try the real login request.
login.tutorialDemo: Tutorial demonstration · not a real request
login.reviewRequest: Review the real login request in Hive Keychain.
login.authenticatedAs: Authenticated as @{{username}}. Your private key stayed in Keychain.
login.authenticationApproved: Authentication approved. Your private key stayed in Keychain.
login.openFailed: Keychain could not open the request. The tutorial has switched to simulation mode.
login.cancelled: Login cancelled. No request was approved.
login.simulatedApprovedDetail: Authentication approved. Your private key stayed on your device.
login.simulatedApproved: Login approved in this tutorial simulation.
safety.title: Stay safe
safety.description: Three rules that keep your account secure. That's it, keep these in mind and you're most of the way there.
safety.rule1Description: No legitimate app or person will ever ask for your private keys. Keep them to yourself.
safety.rule2Description: Read the request before you tap Approve. Understand what action Keychain is about to sign.
safety.rule3Description: Store your keys safely offline. A secure backup is how you recover access if you ever need to.
safety.warningTitle: A website asks you to paste your Active Key?
safety.warningDescription: Don't do it. Use Keychain to approve the action instead, your key never leaves your device.
ready.title: Time to become a Hiver.
ready.description: You now know the basics. The rest is yours to explore.
